description: The file defines the KuraProtocolAdapter class, a final Java class extending an abstract MQTT protocol adapter tailored for Eclipse Kura gateways. It handles topic mapping, message processing, and integration with Hono's APIs, specifically for publishing telemetry and event messages in a Kura environment.

classes.name: KuraProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A final class implementing a Vert.x based MQTT protocol adapter for Eclipse Kura gateways, handling message mapping and publishing logic.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of the protocol adapter, specifically 'kura'.

methods.name: onPublishedMessage
methods.description: Handles actions to take upon message publication, including topic mapping and uploading messages.

methods.name: mapTopic
methods.description: Maps an MQTT topic to a Kura-specific resource identifier, handling control and data messages based on QoS.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the appropriate endpoint string based on MQTT QoS level — either telemetry or event.
